author: Eclipciz
body:
Hello, I was banned way back in July of 2015.

I was banned for hacking, I fully admit to that, but since it was so long ago and I don't hack anymore I think I should be unbanned.

My other appeal was denied months ago for ban evading. Which I haven't done since that appeal. 

All hacked clients have been removed from my computer since then, and I am truly sorry for hacking and ban evading.

Thank you for taking time to read this appeal.

~Eclipciz
